    function renderAuctionCallQueue() {
      if (
        !auctionCallMode()
        ||
        !(auctionHasPresidentRole() || auctionHasViceRole())
      ) {
        return '';
      }

      const rows =
        auctionQueueRows();

      const projectedQueue =
        auctionQueueProjection(rows);

      const backupByPlayerId =
        new Map(
          projectedQueue.map(entry => [
            entry.item?.player_id,
            entry
          ])
        );

      const editable =
        auctionCanManageCallQueue();

      const viceView =
        auctionHasViceRole()
        && !auctionHasPresidentRole();

      const queueSettings =
        state.auction?.callQueueSettings
        || {};

      const autoPaused =
        queueSettings.autoPaused === true;

      const isPrivate =
        queueSettings.private === true;

      const manualCallAvailable =
        autoPaused
        && auctionOwnCallTurn()
        && !auctionSession()?.current_player_id;

      return `
        <section
          id="auction-call-queue-drawer"
          class="auction-central-queue"
        >
          <div class="auction-call-queue-drawer-content">

            <section class="auction-call-queue auction-team-roster ${isPrivate && !viceView ? 'is-private' : ''}">

              <div class="auction-call-queue-head auction-team-roster-head">

                <div class="auction-call-queue-title">
                  <strong>${viceView ? 'Coda del Presidente' : 'Prossime chiamate'}</strong>
                  <span class="badge primary">${rows.length}</span>
                </div>

                ${
                  viceView
                    ? `<span class="badge">VICE · sola lettura</span>`
                    : `
                        <div class="auction-call-queue-head-actions">
                          <button
                            id="auction-queue-autoplay"
                            type="button"
                            class="${autoPaused ? 'good' : 'warn'}"
                            ${editable ? '' : 'disabled'}
                            title="${autoPaused ? 'Riprende le chiamate automatiche dalla prima voce valida' : 'Mette in pausa le chiamate automatiche per scegliere manualmente'}"
                          >
                            ${autoPaused ? 'RIPRENDI' : 'PAUSA'}
                          </button>

                          <label
                            class="auction-queue-private-toggle ${isPrivate ? 'is-private' : ''}"
                            title="${isPrivate ? 'La coda è offuscata sullo schermo' : 'Offusca nome, ruolo e prezzo della coda sullo schermo'}"
                          >
                            <input
                              id="auction-queue-private"
                              type="checkbox"
                              ${isPrivate ? 'checked' : ''}
                              ${editable ? '' : 'disabled'}
                            >
                            <span>${isPrivate ? 'OFFUSCATA' : 'OFFUSCA'}</span>
                          </label>
                        </div>
                      `
                }

              </div>

              ${
                viceView
                  ? `<div class="auction-queue-mode-note is-auto">Indica interesse o prezzo desiderato: il Presidente lo vede in tempo reale.</div>`
                  : autoPaused
                    ? `<div class="auction-queue-mode-note">Coda in pausa · al tuo turno usa ✓ per scegliere la chiamata.</div>`

                          }
                        </div>
                      `
                }

              </div>

            </section>

          </div>
        </section>
      `;
    }


    function attachAuctionQueueDrawerToggle() {
      $('auction-call-queue-drawer')
        ?.addEventListener(
          'toggle',
          event => {
            state.auctionQueueOpen =
              event.currentTarget.open;
          }
        );
    }


    function attachAuctionRosterQueueToggle() {
      $('auction-roster-queue-toggle')
        ?.addEventListener(
          'change',
          event => {
            state.auctionShowQueueInRoster =
              event.currentTarget.checked;

            renderAuctionLive();
          }
        );
    }



    function auctionOptimisticQueueRows(items) {
      const currentRows =
        auctionQueueRows();

      const candidates =
        state.auction?.callCandidates
        || [];

      return items.map((item, index) => {
        const playerId =
          item.playerId;

        const existing =
          currentRows.find(row =>
            row.player_id === playerId
          );

        const player =
          existing?.player
          || candidates.find(candidate =>
            candidate.id === playerId
          )
          || null;

        return {
          ...(existing || {}),
          player_id: playerId,
          player,
          opening_bid: Math.max(1, Number(item.openingBid || 1)),
          position: index + 1
        };
      });
    }

              }
            );
